category_id.description: UUID of the category being evaluated.

proposed_expansions.description: Proposed expansions. Empty if no novelty.

target_element.description: Name of the existing property/condition/consequence being expanded. Only for dimensional_expansion.

new_element_name.description: Proposed name for the new property/condition/consequence/strategy. Only for 'new_*' types.

description.description: Description of the expansion: what it adds to the current paradigm_state

evidence_quote.description: Exact textual quote from the incident supporting this expansion

incident_index.description: Index of the incident in new_incidents that originates this expansion

expansion_nature.description: dimensional=more of the same in new degree. essential=qualitatively new aspect.

relation_to_core.description: How this expansion relates to the core {object_of_study}

did_state_expand.description: TRUE if at least one new incident expands the paradigm. FALSE if all map to existing items. Used by saturation loop to track expansion streaks.

elaboration_type.description: Type of elaboration: 'expanded' if did_state_expand=true, 'converges' if did_state_expand=false (confirming saturation), or 'NONE'.

elaboration_note.description: Methodological note explaining what was expanded and why, or why nothing was expanded.

expanded_definition.description: Updated category definition incorporating the new expansions. Only present when did_state_expand=true. If empty, definition unchanged.

confirmed_only.description: true if ALL incidents only confirm existing properties (no expansions)

synthesis_note.description: Synthesis note: is the category stabilizing or still revealing variation?
